section: Section 4 - Special Design Requirements for Structural Members and Systems

subclauses.title: Base Area of Footing
subclauses.text: The base area of the footing shall be determined from the external loads and moments transmitted to the footing and the allowable safe bearing capacity (SBC) of the ground, adding approximately 10 percent for self-weight of footing and backfill (A >= 1.1 * P / qa).

subclauses.title: Thickness at Edge of Footing
subclauses.text: In reinforced and plain concrete footings, the thickness at the edge shall be not less than 150 mm for footings on soil, nor less than 300 mm above the tops of piles for footings on piles.

subclauses.title: Bending Moment in Footings
subclauses.text: The greatest bending moment to be used in the design of an isolated concrete footing which supports a column, pedestal or wall, shall be the moment computed on vertical sections through the footing, taken at the face of the column, pedestal or wall.

subclauses.title: Shear and Bond - One-Way and Two-Way (Punching) Shear
subclauses.text: The shear strength of footings is governed by the more severe of: (a) One-way shear: checked at a distance d from the face of the column, where nominal shear stress tau_v <= tau_c from Table 19; (b) Two-way (punching) shear: checked along a critical perimeter at a distance d/2 from the periphery of the column, where nominal shear stress tau_v <= ks * tau_c, ks = min(0.5 + beta_c, 1.0) and tau_c = 0.25 * sqrt(fck).

subclauses.title: Distribution of Tensile Reinforcement
subclauses.text: In two-way square footings, reinforcement extending in each direction shall be distributed uniformly across the entire width. In two-way rectangular footings, reinforcement in the short direction shall be distributed such that a central band portion equal to 2 / (beta + 1) is placed in the central band equal to the short dimension, where beta is the ratio of long side to short side.

verification.verification_notes: Digitized from Section 4 Clause 34 for isolated reinforced concrete footings.
